data.name: Jannah
data.gender_notes: Jannah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Jannah refers to the paradise described in the Quran, a place of eternal bliss and happiness. The name Jannah carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jannah usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A place of ultimate peace and tranquility, where the righteous will reside after the Day of Judgment.
data.etymology: Jannah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جنة
in_arabic.meaning: الجنة هي اسم للجنة في الإسلام، وتعني النعيم والخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجنة هي كلمة عربية تعني الجنة أو النعيم، وهي مشتقة من الجذر العربي 'ج-ن-ن' الذي يعني التغطية أو الحماية. في الإسلام، الجنة هي المكان الذي وعد الله به المؤمنين يوم القيامة، وتوصف بأنها دار النعيم والخير، حيث يتمتع أهلها بالنعم والخيرات. الجنة ذكرت في القرآن الكريم أكثر من 70 مرة، وهي تعتبر من أهم المفاهيم في الإسلام.

in_urdu.meaning: جنت کا مطلب ہے جہت یا نیکی کی جگہ

in_hindi.name: जन्नत
in_hindi.meaning: जन्नत का अर्थ है स्वर्ग या अच्छाई का स्थान
in_hindi.long_meaning: जन्नत इस्लामी परंपरा में एक ऐसी जगह है जहां अच्छे लोगों को मृत्यु के बाद इनाम दिया जाता है। यह शब्द अरबी जड़ 'ज-न-न' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है कवर करना या सुरक्षा करना। हिंदी में, जन्नत का प्रयोग स्वर्ग या जन्नत के अर्थ में किया जाता है, जहां मुसलमानों को उनकी अच्छी क्रियाओं के बदले में प्रवेश करने का वादा किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Jannah
in_english.meaning: Paradise or heaven in Islam, a place of bliss and reward
in_english.long_meaning: Jannah is the Islamic concept of paradise or heaven, a place where believers are rewarded for their good deeds. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ن-ن' (j-n-n), meaning 'to cover' or 'to protect', Jannah signifies a place of safety, bliss, and protection. In the Quran, Jannah is mentioned over 70 times and is described as a garden of delights, where the righteous will dwell in comfort and happiness. The concept of Jannah holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the ultimate reward for the faithful.
